mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from Generative Engine Optimization for a remodeling business?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline to see results from Generative Engine Optimization can vary, but most remodeling businesses typically observe initial improvements in online visibility and lead inquiries within 3 to 6 months. Significant improvements in search rankings and sustained lead generation often become more apparent over 6 to 12 months. Factors like the competitiveness of your market, the current state of your online presence, and the consistency of GEO implementation all influence the speed of results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial GEO results usually appear within 3-6 months, with more significant improvements over 6-12 months, depending on market competitiveness and implementation consistency.
